newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Pictet repeats Novartis buy advice.
newsitem.headline: Pictet repeats Novartis buy advice.

text.p: Pictet & Cie said it was holding its buy recommendation on life sciences group Novartis AG and raising its estimates for pharmaceuticals sales growth to 10 percent from eight percent in local currencies for the 1996-2001 period.
Pictet also said its price target for the stock was 2,700 to 3,000 Swiss francs by the end of 1998 based on a P/E ratio for estimated 1998 earnings of 23-times to 25-times.
This leaves approximately 20-30 percent upside potential from current prices on an 18-month basis, Pictet said.
The estimates were based on evidence that the integration process following the merger of Ciba-Geigy and Sandoz which formed Novartis is proceeding at least as well as expected.
Pictet also said Novartis had one of the richest and most promising drug pipelines in the industry.

The comments, published in a weekly report, were part of a brief summary following a recent Novartis presentation to analysts. Pictet expects to produce a more comprehensive report in the near future.
